'''Kamasau''' is an endangered [[Torricelli languages|Torricelli language]] of [[Turubu Rural LLG]], [[East Sepik Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]].<ref name="UN-PNG">{{cite web |url=https://data.humdata.org/dataset/village-coordinates-lookup |title=Papua New Guinea Village Coordinates Lookup |author=United Nations in Papua New Guinea |work=Humanitarian Data Exchange |version=1.31.9 |date=2018}}</ref>

==Dialects==
There are three dialects:<ref name=e25/><ref name="UN-PNG"/>
*''Ghini'' dialect, spoken in Wandomi ({{coord|-3.868514|143.865581|type:city_region:PG|name=Wandomin}}), Wobu ({{coord|-3.919328|143.933212|type:city_region:PG|name=Wobu}}), and Yibab ({{coord|-3.866041|143.860699|type:city_region:PG|name=Ibab}}) villages
*''Hagi'' dialect, spoken in Kenyari village ({{coord|-3.761477|143.751797|type:city_region:PG|name=Kinyari}})
*''Soigi'' and ''Segi'' dialects, spoken in Kamasau ({{coord|-3.735538|143.815344|type:city_region:PG|name=Kamasau}}), Tring ({{coord|-3.790725|143.841425|type:city_region:PG|name=Tring (Tiling)}}), and Wau ({{coord|-3.787993|143.87474|type:city_region:PG|name=Wau 1 & 2}}) villages

Ghini dialect is divergent.{{citation needed|date=October 2024}} The dictionary{{which|date=October 2024}} is based on the Segi dialect of Tring.{{citation needed|date=October 2024}}
